n_4a189d943eba21c8.name: Configure start time
n_4a189d943eba21c8.source: export default function plan({startDate}){if(typeof startDate!=='string'||!/(?:Z|[+-]\d\d:\d\d)$/i.test(startDate.trim())||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(startDate)))throw Error('Enter an ISO start date and time with Z or a UTC offset');return{startDate:new Date(startDate).toISOString()}}

n_0b161fef041aa7d2.name: Use the activity ID
n_0b161fef041aa7d2.source: export default function activityId({activity}){const id=activity?.id;if(!(Number.isSafeInteger(id)&&id>0)&&!(typeof id==='string'&&/^\d+$/.test(id)&&Number(id)>0))throw Error('Strava returned no valid activity ID');return{id}}
